concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-webhook-types]] — 2026-09-15 Capital webhook taxonomy for account-holder offers, grant lifecycle, grant-related transfer subtype/direction and booked transaction correlation; event families are distinct evidence grains.
warnings: Grant initiation can emit only Capital notifications; offer/grant webhook presence does not prove a transfer or payout.
For unscheduled repayment, retain both capitalFundsCollection and repayment transfer types and incoming/outgoing legs; event-envelope type differs from transfer subtype.

This hub supplies no exhaustive status values, Configuration webhook or event-name deprecation rule. Transaction-to-transfer/grant correlation is specified, but no actual debt outcome or external bank receipt is proven.
